content_policy: Mechanical, unreviewed extract. Records section numbers, headings, table captions, counts and SHA-256 digests only; no specification prose. Statements are sentences containing an uppercase RFC 2119 keyword; keyword-free prose is counted separately as keywordless blocks (ordinals in keywordless_at) and table rows are counted per table; neither is classified. Keyword matching cannot establish exhaustiveness. Counts are not clause coverage.
statement_format: <first 16 hex of SHA-256 of normalized sentence> <p|t: prose or table> <keywords>
